title: Compliance Q&A Verdict
description: Structured verdict produced by the Compliance Q&A portal: one auditor question against one policy document.

question.description: The compliance question asked by the auditor

document.description: Filename or identifier of the source document

confidence_reasoning.description: Short paragraph explaining WHY the confidence is this high/low.

information_needed.description: 2-5 concrete artefacts or facts that would raise the confidence if supplied. Empty when confidence is 95+.

auditor_additional_info.description: Extra context the auditor supplied that was re-evaluated into this verdict.

reevaluated.description: True if this verdict was computed after the auditor supplied additional_info.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes from the document that support the verdict

exact_quote.description: Verbatim substring of the source document

ai_reasoning.description: One-paragraph explanation of how the evidence supports the status

auditor_judgement.description: Free-text judgement added by the auditor on top of the AI verdict
